definitions.explanation: The time of day when light first appears in the sky; the beginning of morning.
The start of a new era, period, or development.

examples.japanese: {夜明|よあ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
{夜明|よあ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しかった→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The sky at dawn was beautiful.

examples.notes: A common saying meaning things are worst just before they get better

examples.english: That revolution was a historic turning point where the old system collapsed and became the dawn of a new society.

notes:
{夜明|よあ}け refers to the time when darkness gives way to light — the transition from night to morning. It is also commonly used figuratively for the beginning of a new era or period.

FORMS:
{夜|よ} (night) + ⟦{明|あ}け→明け：13157_ake⟧ (opening, dawning) = the end of night

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {夜明|よあ}け⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: before dawn
- {夜明|よあ}け⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ともに→共に：03468_tomoni⟧: at the break of dawn
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{夜明|よあ}け: the dawn of ~ (figurative)
- {夜明|よあ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧: to wait for dawn

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{明|あ}け{方|がた}→明け方：17595_akegata⟧: early morning, around dawn (more colloquial)
- ⟦{暁|あかつき}→暁：10036_akatsuki⟧: dawn (literary/poetic)
- ⟦{日|ひ}の{出|で}→日の出：17596_hinode⟧: sunrise (the specific moment the sun appears)
- ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧: morning (general)

SAYING:
{夜明|よあ}け⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧ — "It's darkest before dawn." Used to encourage someone that things will improve after a difficult period.
